product.title: Bryce Canyon Stargazing Adventure

description.text: Explore the wonders of the universe on this Bryce Canyon Stargazing Tour, led by expert guides eager to share the mysteries of the night sky. Begin with a brief orientation before engaging with state-of-the-art telescopes to identify constellations, planets, and galaxies. Depending on the season, you’ll witness stunning celestial objects and have opportunities for deep-sky astrophotography. Ideal for visitors basing near Bryce Canyon City who want a guided red-rock experience without coordinating park entrances, trailheads, or photo stops on their own.

highlights: Duration of 90 minutes with flexible start times based on the season
Minimum group size of 2 guests required for the tour to proceed
Warm clothing is recommended as temperatures drop after sunset
Experience the best views during the new moon phase, with tours available nightly year round

start.description: Meet your guide at the confirmed Bryce Canyon meeting location listed when booking, typically near Bryce Canyon City or the park entrance area shown at booking.

end.description: Return to your Bryce Canyon meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
